Hey guys! In this document I am going to add up the regionally elevated genes in humans, pigs and mice in the **forebrain**.
```{r}
humans <- sum(180, 83, 57, 110)
pigs <- sum(109, 157, 31, 45)
mouse <- sum(55, 185, 60, 98)

print(humans)
print(pigs)
print(mouse)
```
Humans have 430 regionally elevated genes, pigs have 342 and mice have 398. Therefore, **humans** have the highest number of genes with regionally elevated expression.
